hyperedges.rationale: Adam (M027) is Momentum's first-moment gradient tracking (M022) combined with RMSProp's second-moment/adaptive-per-parameter-learning-rate tracking (M026), plus bias correction for both. Neither premise alone entails Adam -- momentum alone gives plain momentum-SGD, and RMSProp alone gives adaptive-LR without momentum (see pairs.json P08/P09, both COMPATIBLE not ENTAILS).
